Home.name: PALAROS
Home.tagline: Registration, scoring, standings and payments for Filipino community sports leagues in Saudi Arabia. Made for phones, simple enough for everyone.
Home.eyebrow: For Filipino leagues in Saudi Arabia
Home.headline: Run your league <accent>without the paperwork</accent>
Home.sampleLabel: Example of a live game score
Home.featuresIntro: No more paper scoresheets, group-chat sign-ups or standings worked out by hand.

register.title: Team registration
register.body: Share one link. Managers register their team and roster, and player ratings are checked automatically.

score.title: Digital scoresheet
score.body: Score every point, foul and timeout in a tap or two. It keeps working without internet and prints the official scoresheet.

standings.title: Automatic standings
standings.body: Approve a result and the standings update by themselves, with the tiebreakers already worked out.

schedule.title: Schedules in minutes
schedule.body: Make a round-robin schedule for each division, then adjust dates, times and courts.

payments.title: Team payments
payments.body: Track full or per-game payments in SAR, add fines, and see which teams are behind.

share.title: Public league page
share.body: Fans follow schedules, results and standings, and share them on WhatsApp and Facebook.

setUp.title: Set up your season
setUp.body: The commissioner adds divisions, rules, the fee and the registration deadline.

invite.title: Teams sign up
invite.body: Send the registration link. Approve teams or send them back with a note.

play.title: Play and keep score
play.body: The scorer unlocks each game with a PIN. Results, standings and payments stay up to date.

Home.audienceTitle: Made for everyone in the league

commissioners.title: Commissioners
commissioners.body: A to-do list of what needs you: approvals, unpaid teams and results to check.

managers.title: Team managers
managers.body: Register, manage your roster and see your games and payments.

scorers.title: Scorers
scorers.body: No account needed. Enter the game PIN and start scoring.

fans.title: Players and fans
fans.body: Schedules, scores and standings, open to everyone.

Home.ctaBody: Create your account in a minute. Your commissioner can add you to their league.
Home.footer: Made for Filipino community leagues in Saudi Arabia.
